items.description: A busy Premier League Sunday, with five matches, including Liverpool against Brighton.

items.title: Who has made Troy's Premier League team of the week?
items.description: After every round of Premier League matches this season, Troy Deeney gives us his team of the week. Do you agree with his choices?

items.title: Mbappe's late strike earns Mourinho and Real Clasico glory at Barca
items.description: Kylian Mbappe's double took Real Madrid to a famous 2-1 Clasico win, which had Jose Mourinho sliding on his knees in celebration in Barcelona.

items.title: What have Man Utd changed to turn around WSL form?
items.description: It is a different picture at Manchester United now than it was last month - and they proved it to fight back and earn a point against rivals Manchester City.

items.title: Papers: Dyche emerges as frontrunner for Palace job if Sage departs
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Monday's newspapers...

items.title: End approaching for Carrick but Man Utd fans make clear who they blame
items.description: Manchester United's fans sang their support for Michael Carrick during the 3-0 home defeat by Bournemouth, but voiced their opposition to virtually everything else.

items.title: Howe open to Man Utd talks - Monday's gossip
items.description: Eddie Howe is open to holding talks with Manchester United if they part ways with manager Michael Carrick, three Premier League clubs are monitoring Bayern Munich's Lennart Karl, plus more.

items.title: Pressure intensifies on Carrick as Man Utd lose to Bournemouth
items.description: Manchester United's winless run stretches to eight matches in all competitions as they are beaten 3-0 by Bournemouth at Old Trafford - a defeat that leaves United's manager Michael Carrick under severe pressure.

items.title: Liverpool earn first league win at Anfield with victory over Brighton
items.description: An own goal from Brighton's Pascal Gross swiftly followed by a goal from Alexander Isak, sees Liverpool beat the Seagulls 2-0 at Anfield to move into the Premier League top four.

items.title: Watch: Sportscene - Sunday's Scottish Premiership highlights
items.description: With Hibs v Celtic and Motherwell v Hearts, plus action and reaction from Saturday

items.title: Sage continues to struggle as Palace lose at home to Newcastle
items.description: Crystal Palace's winless run stretches to four matches as they are beaten 2-0 at home by Newcastle, leaving the club just a point outside the relegation zone with the pressure mounting on manager Pierre Sage.
